evals.prompt: We need invoice reminder emails going out 3 and 7 days after an invoice's due date, using the Resend setup that already lives in `server/email/` (the `sendTemplate` helper and the `templates/` folder). The invoices table is in `db/schema/invoices.ts`; nothing tracks reminders yet. This is for the vegastack/billing repo, which has a `.vegastack/dev.md` with the default labels. Please turn this into a GitHub issue I can approve.
evals.expected_output: A draft issue body in the brief format — scope class with its reason, Outcome, Out of scope, Rules and edge cases, Approach and touch points naming the existing email helper and the missing reminder state, Tests and acceptance, Risks — with every open question carrying a recommended answer, ending with a request for the operator's approval rather than a created issue.
assertions: The draft opens with the line `<!-- vsk:v1 type=brief rev=1 scope=... -->` naming one of research, small, medium
The **Scope:** line names the class and gives its reason in the same line
Every open question or assumption in the draft carries a recommended answer
No implementation code (function bodies, SQL, route handlers) appears in the draft
The draft is presented for approval; no `gh issue create` is run and no `queued` label is proposed before the operator says yes

evals.prompt: users say login 500s sometimes on mobile, maybe since the session-cookie change last week (PR #212, `server/auth/session.ts`) — can't repro on desktop. write it up as an issue
evals.expected_output: Either a fix-type brief whose Reproduction section states concrete steps or artifacts to obtain (device, network, the exact request), or a research-scoped issue that says plainly the bug cannot yet be reproduced and what evidence would close it; Out of scope names adjacent auth work not being touched.
assertions: The draft either has a `## Reproduction` section with concrete steps or artifacts, or is classified `research` with the stated reason that no reproduction exists yet
The suspected cause (the session-cookie change in PR #212) is recorded as a suspect, not asserted as the cause
The `## Out of scope` section names at least one adjacent piece of auth work the issue will not touch
The title carries a `fix:` or `research:` prefix matching the chosen scope

evals.prompt: Here's the signed SOW at `docs/sow-acme.md` — 14 deliverables across onboarding, billing, and reporting for the Acme rollout. Make issues out of it so the team can start.
evals.expected_output: An epic map (Destination, Decisions so far, Not clear yet, Out of scope) with the deliverables grouped into child issues, each child classified independently, every child waiting on approval — the SOW is sliced, not rubber-stamped into fourteen ready tickets.
assertions: The output proposes one epic parent whose body has the four map sections: Destination, Decisions so far, Not clear yet, Out of scope
Each proposed child issue carries its own scope class (research, small, or medium) with a reason
No child is proposed with the `queued` label; every child is presented for the operator's approval
Unclear deliverables are listed under Not clear yet with a question each, rather than silently assigned a class

evals.prompt: Add a --since flag to our status script in vegastack/example-service; the flag parsing already lives in scripts/status.mjs. Write it up as an issue.
evals.expected_output: A small brief whose numbered interview questions include one for Priority and one for Effort, each carrying a recommended answer drawn from the options the org actually defines, so that replying "all recommended" answers both; the draft body carries **Priority:** and **Effort:** lines under **Scope:**.
assertions: The numbered questions include one for Priority and one for Effort, each carrying a recommended answer
The recommended Effort is justified by the scope class rather than by an invented letter scale
The option names offered come from gh api orgs/<org>/issue-fields, not from a guess
Replying 'all recommended' answers both questions
The draft body carries **Priority:** and **Effort:** lines under **Scope:**

evals.prompt: You are running headless in vegastack/example-service with no question tool available in this harness. Turn this request into an issue: "Send customers a reminder email three days after an invoice falls due."
evals.expected_output: A stub issue is created first at waiting-on-operator with the operator assigned and the request as its body, because the round needs a comment surface; then the interview round is posted as one issue comment opening <!-- vsk:v1 type=questions rev=1 -->, with the questions wrapped in <questions> tags, numbered **Q1.** style and lettered - a) style, exactly one option per question marked (recommended — <reason>), and a closing reply line naming `all recommended`; the issue is left at waiting-on-operator with no brief written and no ready label proposed.
assertions: The issue is created before the round is posted, at waiting-on-operator with the operator assigned, and the round is posted as a comment on it
The round is posted as one issue comment whose first line is <!-- vsk:v1 type=questions rev=1 -->
The questions sit inside <questions> tags, numbered **Q1.** style with - a) lettered options
Exactly one option per question is marked (recommended — <reason>) and the reason is given
The closing reply line names `all recommended`
The issue is left at waiting-on-operator and no ready label is proposed
No harness question tool is claimed to have been used
